requirements.statement: A bounded deterministic coordinator streams sparse chunks, commits storage candidates and rejects stale derived work across unbounded horizontal traversal.
acceptance: Long positive and negative traversal has bounded queues and residency with no world edge.
Randomized request and task completion order produce identical committed chunks.

requirements.statement: Versioned cave topology, portals, occupancy and hydrology compose deterministically across planning domains and chunk faces.
acceptance: The required surface-to-underground journey reaches both domains.
Portal, shared-face, fluid and connectivity assertions pass under reordered evaluation.
